issue.body:
### Summary

If a Chat session has not been prompted yet, "Switch to terminal UI" does not work and the app says nothing. The menu item is there and looks normal, but clicking it does nothing at all. No error, no message, no spinner. The session just stays in Chat. Sending one message first makes the switch work. Behind the scenes the daemon rejects the request with 409 NATIVE_SESSION_MISSING, but the desktop app never shows that to the user.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a project and create a session in Chat UI.
2. Do not send any message.
3. Open the ⋮ menu in the session topbar. "Switch to terminal UI" is there and clickable.
4. Click it.

Nothing happens. Clicking again just repeats the failed request.
Now send one message, wait for the reply, and try the switch again. It works.

Video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a1d7f72d-401d-46ce-b2ec-ecb7679dae85


### Expected behavior

One of these:

- the switch works, since a Chat session with no messages has no conversation to lose, or
- the app tells the user why it cannot switch, and ideally greys out the menu item until it can

Silently doing nothing is the problem.


### Actual behavior

```
POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/interface-transition  ->  409

{"error":"conflict","code":"NATIVE_SESSION_MISSING",
"message":"The agent has not exposed a native conversation that can resume in the other interface"}
```

but the status endpoint still says the switch is available:

```
GET /api/v1/sessions/{id}/interface-transition  ->  {"supported":true,"targetMode":"tui"}
```

Nothing is written to `session_interface_transitions`, so it is refused during preflight.

**Why the user sees nothing.** Checked on `2e0614fc2`:

- `SessionView.tsx:931` starts the switch.
- `SessionView.tsx:937-940` catches the failure in an empty `catch` block.
- The error is only ever displayed in one place, `SessionView.tsx:1687`, where it is passed to `SessionInterfaceSwitchDialog`.
- That dialog only opens when the session is busy and the user has to pick drain or interrupt. A plain switch does not open it, so the error has nowhere to render.
- `useSessionInterfaceTransition.ts` has no `onError` on the start mutation, and there is no global handler either.

So the error is captured and then dropped.

**Why the daemon refuses.** For claude-code, AO checks whether the conversation exists by looking for the transcript file at
`~/.claude/projects/<project-key>/<uuid>.jsonl`. Claude reserves the session UUID immediately but does not write that file until the
conversation has content, so on a fresh session the file is not there.

There is a fallback, `nativeConversationNotStarted` at `interface_transition.go:542`, that allows a fresh handoff when nothing has started. It
does not help here because its first condition (`interface_transition.go:547`) requires the session to be in TUI mode.

Worth flagging for whoever fixes this: just removing that TUI check would not be enough. The fallback proves "nothing started" by reading the terminal output, and a Chat session has no terminal and an empty `runtime_handle_id`. The Chat direction needs different evidence, for example "this conversation has no messages".

### AO version

0.10.3 dev build, reproduced on commit 2d01919c2. Code unchanged on current main 2e0614fc2, and all line numbers above refer to 2e0614fc2.

### Environment

Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS x86_64, kernel 6.14, Node v22.16.0, Electron dev build

### Logs / extra context

```shell
Daemon log while reproducing, every attempt the same:


level=INFO msg="http request" method=POST path=/api/v1/sessions/clove_v2-7/interface-transition status=409 bytes=215 level=INFO msg="http request" method=POST path=/api/v1/sessions/clove_v2-8/interface-transition status=409 bytes=215


  Session row while it was failing: `agent_session_id`, `runtime_launch_id`, `native_transcript_path`, `latest_user_prompt` and
  `latest_assistant_update` all empty, `session_mode` chat.

  I also checked this against all 20 sessions in my local database. Every session whose conversation UUID had a transcript file on disk could
  switch, and every session without one got the 409.
```

### Before submitting

- [x] I searched existing issues for duplicates
- [x] I removed secrets / tokens from logs and screenshots
